page.overview:
Who is Persons of Interest?

Persons of Interest is a section of Active Time Lore in Final Fantasy XVI that shows information on the game's cast of characters. The available characters to view on the field are the ones depicted in the cutscene and/or the ones related to current plot events. The entire Persons of Interest section of Active Time Lore can be viewed at the Thousand Tomes library at Cid's Hideaway and the Hideaway.

Firstborn son of Archduke Elwin, ruler of Rosaria. Though all expected him to inherit the Phoenix's flames and awaken as its Dominant, destiny instead chose his younger brother Joshua to bear that burden. In search of a role of his own, Clive dedicated himself to mastering the blade—and his practice paid off when he was appointed the First Shield of Rosaria, tasked to guard the Phoenix and blessed with the ability to wield a part of his fire. First Encounter & At Rosalith Castle

Firstborn son of Archduke Elwin and First Shield of Rosaria. Though it was his sworn duty to protect his father and younger brother, both lost their lives in a tragedy brought about his mother, Duchess Anabella. Taken into custody by the imperial army, he was branded as a Bearer and forced to serve as a slave soldier. After the Fall of Phoenix Gate

;Wyvern A slave soldier for the Holy Empire of Sanbreque, now in his thirteenth year of servitude. Though drafted as a frontline infantryman, the magical might granted him by the Blessing of the Phoenix quickly saw him promoted to an elite squadron of assassins, where he was assigned the moniker by which he is now known. Their latest mission: to descend into the Nysa Defile, where bloody battle rages between the Iron Kingdom and the Republic of Dhalmekia, and take the head of Shiva's Dominant. At the Battle of Nysa
